description: Material Design 3 shell, ADB, and Fastboot utility for Android aShell You is an advanced shell and device management utility featuring a clean Material Design 3 interface. Execute ADB and shell commands on your local device or manage external devices via Wireless Debugging and USB OTG without requiring a PC. Key Features - Multi-Target Execution: Run commands locally via Shizuku or root, and remotely over Wi-Fi (pairing code/QR) or USB OTG. - Fastboot OTG: Flash partitions, switch active slots (A/B), and execute bootloader operations over USB OTG. - Screen Mirroring: Stream and interact with connected devices in real time with low-latency embedded scrcpy. - Real-Time Logcat: Inspect system logs with tag search, regex filtering, and color-coded priority markers. - ADB Sideload: Flash recovery update zip packages directly over USB OTG with live progress verification. - Port Forwarding: Configure local and remote TCP port forwarding (adb forward/reverse) with active tunnel monitoring. - Remote File Browser: Browse, push, pull, and manage files on connected targets. - Command Examples & Bookmarks: Built-in catalog of common Android commands with custom bookmarking. - Quick Settings Tiles: Launch custom shell scripts or toggle wireless debugging from the notification shade. - Output Utilities: Continuous command streaming (top, logcat), text search, and text file export/sharing. - Material Design 3: Dynamic colors, AMOLED dark theme, and interface scaling customization. Requirements - Local device execution requires Shizuku or root access (or local wireless debugging). - Managing remote devices via OTG or Wi-Fi does not require root or Shizuku on the host device. - Basic familiarity with ADB and shell commands is recommended. Translations Contribute translations via Crowdin: https://crowdin.com/project/ashellyou
